# qChat – Advanced Minecraft Chat Plugin

**Version:** 1.0
**Minecraft:** 1.21+ (Paper/Spigot)
**Author:** QPlay Studios

---

## Description

qChat is a **powerful and fully customizable chat plugin** for Minecraft servers, designed to enhance communication and control across your server. With advanced **HEX & gradient colors**, personal auto-messages, chat management tools, and admin features, qChat brings a modern and dynamic chat experience to your players.

Whether you want a fully vibrant chat, private conversations, or moderation tools, qChat has everything you need.

---

## Features

* **Global Chat**: Fully supports HEX colors, gradients, and Minecraft legacy colors (`&a`, `&c`)
* **Private Messaging**: `/msg` and `/reply` with full color support
* **Personal Auto-Messages**: `/automsg <player>` sends all your messages automatically as PM to a target player
* **Admin Chat Controls**:

  * `/qca clear` – clear chat
  * `/qca lock [time] [reason]` – lock chat
  * `/qca unlock [reason]` – unlock chat
  * `/qca slowmode <seconds>` – set chat cooldown
* **Player Management**:

  * `/qca disable-login <player> <time> <reason>` – temporarily block player login
  * `/qca enable-login <player>` – unblock login
  * `/qca warn / mute / unmute / kick / ban / unban <player>`
* **Filters & Moderation**: Automatic word filtering with custom actions (warn, mute, log)
* **Server & Player Stats**: `/stats <player>` and `/serverstats` monitor server performance and player usage (RAM, ping, TPS)
* **Logging**: All chat and admin actions are logged in `.db` + `.log` files
* **Language Support**: Multi-language support with `lang_en`, `lang_pl`, and custom translations
* **Configuration**: Fully configurable via `config.yml` – set chat prefix, auto-messages, slowmode, filters, and more

---

## Example Commands

```
/qc help
/qc list
/msg Player Hello!
/reply Hi!
/automsg Player
/automsg off
/qca clear
/qca lock 10m Spam
/qca unlock
/qca reload
/qca warn Player Spamming
/qca mute Player 5m
/stats Player
/serverstats
```

---

## Highlights

* Stunning HEX & gradient chat support for creative messages
* Easy-to-use personal auto-messaging system
* Powerful admin tools for server management
* Fully configurable and multi-language ready

---

> Make your server chat **colorful, dynamic, and secure** with qChat – the ultimate chat experience for Minecraft 1.21+!
